purpose: Challenge the selected close-range occupancy mechanism against every nearby frozen family before any Campaign051 value is computed.
numbering_disambiguation: Historical Campaign051 is separate from any prospective Candidate51; it neither activates a second prospective candidate nor changes Candidate49.

selected_mechanism.name: intraday_close_range_occupancy_entropy_10b
selected_mechanism.economic_hypothesis: Broad occupation of the completed-session relative close-price range is consistent with distributed two-sided price discovery rather than a fleeting excursion or terminal congestion, potentially leaving a more resilient close-known state for the next-open-to-third-close horizon.
selected_mechanism.formula: Across the 240 selected closes, let x_i=log(close_i), x_min=min(x), x_max=max(x), and z_i=(x_i-x_min)/(x_max-x_min). Assign b_i=min(floor(10*z_i),9), let p_j=count(b_i=j)/240 for j=0..9, and return -sum_{j:p_j>0}(p_j*log(p_j))/log(10).
selected_mechanism.bin_boundary_rule: left-closed right-open equal-width bins except the exact global maximum is assigned to bin 9

design_choices_frozen_before_values.bin_scale: equal width in normalized log-close location

overlap_challenges.reason: Those mechanisms distribute return power across frequencies or observations. Campaign051 ignores return magnitude and frequency, and distributes close dwell counts across relative price states.
Those mechanisms normalize amount or high-low range mass across clock positions. Campaign051 reads neither amount nor high/low and counts close observations in price-location bins.
Terminal close location uses one final coordinate inside the close range. Campaign051 uses all 240 observations and is invariant to which observation is terminal.
Range-revisit mechanisms merge or overlap OHLC intervals. Campaign051 reads close only and measures dwell allocation rather than interval geometry.
Those mechanisms preserve temporal order relative to a chord or path travel. Campaign051 is deliberately order-invariant and retains only normalized price-state occupancy.

Price-update share and weak-order entropy use exact adjacent equality or local return ordering. Campaign051 retains repeated closes but bins absolute relative close locations with no adjacency or tuple state.
Round-price avoidance is expressed in absolute CNY tick space. Campaign051 normalizes natural-log closes by each stock-day's own min/max and is invariant to multiplicative price level.
Campaign050 selects two endogenous return shocks and terminal retracements. Campaign051 selects no event, direction, return, or time index and summarizes the full close-location distribution.
Campaign051 reads only close and contains no activity field, transaction price, market peer, OHLC range, quarterly data, Candidate49 value, or prospective ledger field.
Campaign051 freezes one ten-bin raw statistic and no fitted weight, alternate bins, filter, threshold, regime, subset, combination, or model.
